title: addystack config
markdownDescription: An addystack config layer: the user's `~/.config/addystack/addystack.jsonc` or the kit's `addystack.defaults.jsonc`. Every key is optional; a missing key falls back to the earlier layers.

$schema.markdownDescription: The absolute path of this schema, `<kit>/schema/v1.json`, so the editor completes and checks the file.

version.markdownDescription: The config format's version. Only `1` exists.

name.markdownDescription: What the instructions call you, such as `Sam`.

hosts.markdownDescription: The agent hosts and machines you use. `build` writes an instruction file only for an enabled host.

t3.markdownDescription: You run agents through T3 Code.

machines.markdownDescription: Other machines that run your agents, by ssh alias, such as `buildbox`.

policy.markdownDescription: How agents work per checkout: `defaults` for every checkout, then each matching `repos` rule over it, field by field, in order.

defaults.markdownDescription: The policy of a checkout no rule matches.

repos.markdownDescription: Rules for some checkouts. Each sets only the fields it names; a later rule wins field by field.

replies.markdownDescription: How agents write their replies to you.

style.markdownDescription: `reply-shape` loads the kit's reply-shape skill and your `rules`; `own` keeps the reply rules in your instructions.

rules.markdownDescription: Your reply rules file, relative to this config's folder, such as `replies.md`, or `null`.

next.markdownDescription: `lettered` ends each stop with a lettered `Next` list.

turnBlock.markdownDescription: End each reply with a machine-readable turn block, for tools such as Prefrontal.

judgment.markdownDescription: The principles and taste agents judge work by.

preset.markdownDescription: `addystack` indexes the kit's principles; `none` leaves the index out.

exclude.markdownDescription: Principles to leave out of the index, by name.

taste.markdownDescription: Your taste file, relative to this config's folder, such as `taste.md`, or `null`.

instructions.markdownDescription: Your own instructions file, relative to this config's folder, such as `global.md`. Its sections merge into the built files by heading.

hooks.markdownDescription: Which of the kit's hooks to install.

preset.markdownDescription: `recommended` installs the safety and workflow hooks; `all` adds the reply and machine hooks.

enable.markdownDescription: Hooks to add to the preset, by id.

disable.markdownDescription: Hooks to remove from the preset, by id.

planning.markdownDescription: `gated` plans with scope-grill and architect and waits at their gates; `autonomous` lets autopilot write its own brief.

trust.markdownDescription: How far agents take a verified stack: `draft` stops at a draft stack, `gate` merges once the merge gate allows it, `merge-on-go` merges when your go names merging.

pushVia.markdownDescription: `gh-stack` sends every branch, push, and PR operation through `gh stack`.

lenses.markdownDescription: Convention skills to load before judging code, by name, or lens files by path relative to this config's folder.

verifySkill.markdownDescription: The skill that proves a change works in the running app, such as `verify-app`, or `null`.

decisionsSection.markdownDescription: PR descriptions carry a Decisions section.

match.markdownDescription: Which checkouts the rule applies to. Every key given must hold.

remote.markdownDescription: A regex searched in the origin remote's URL, ignoring case, such as `[:/]my-org/`.

path.markdownDescription: A glob matched against the checkout's root, such as `~/code/personal/*`.

repoPolicy.markdownDescription: A repo's own `.agents/addystack.jsonc`, committed at its top level. It can only make the policy stricter: each field takes the stricter of this value and the user's, so a cloned repo can't loosen what a user's config enforces.

$schema.markdownDescription: This schema's URL or path, with `#/definitions/repoPolicy`, so the editor completes and checks the file.

rule.markdownDescription: A repo rule: its `match`, and the policy fields it sets.
